newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish WIG seen at 17,573 at end-June - poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish WIG seen at 17,573 at end-June - poll.

text.p: Polish brokers expect the Warsaw bourse's main WIG index to end the first half of the year at 17,573 points and to end the year at 18,600 points, the financial daily Nowa Europa said on Monday.
Last month the brokers expected the main market, currently at 17,704.0 points, to end the first half of the year at 18,131 points and to end the year at 18,544 points.
